interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about food preferences.
questions: Q1: What are some of your favorite foods?
Q2: Have you ever tried cooking a dish from another country?
Q3: How important do you think healthy eating is?
Q4: What advice would you give someone trying to eat healthier?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about outdoor activities.
questions: Q1: What outdoor activities do you enjoy the most?
Q2: Have you faced any challenges when doing outdoor activities?
Q3: In your opinion, why is spending time outdoors important?
Q4: What recommendations do you have for someone new to outdoor activities?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about learning new skills.
questions: Q1: What skill did you recently learn, and how did you start?
Q2: Did you encounter any difficulties while learning this skill?
Q3: Why do you think learning new skills is valuable?
Q4: What tips would you give to someone wanting to learn a new skill?
